text: oh-my-knowledge（OMK）为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）提供 `/omk` 命令：用 `/omk eval <eval.yaml>` 按配置运行评测，并以当前 DSH session 作为执行宿主；用 `/omk observe` 列出已结束会话，或查看指定会话的任务轨迹并生成观测报告。适合在 DSH 中比较提示词版本和回顾任务过程。评测继承当前 DSH 模型；观测需启用 sessionPersistence。

oh-my-knowledge (OMK) adds `/omk eval <eval.yaml>` for controlled evaluations using the current DSH session, and `/omk observe` to list completed sessions or create a task trace report. It inherits the active DSH model; observation requires `sessionPersistence`.
想直接用当前 DSH 模型比较两个提示词或知识工件版本。
想在 DSH 里按评测配置运行回归对照。
让 DSH 帮我评估一组样例，并把结果留在项目目录。
我想查看最近完成的 DSH 会话有哪些。
怎么回看某个 DSH 任务及其子 agent 的执行轨迹？
想把已完成任务的轨迹整理成观测报告。
How can I compare agent or prompt versions using the model already running in DSH?
Show me the trace for a completed DSH task, including delegated sessions.
I want to turn completed DSH session traces into an observation report.
oh-my-knowledge 的功能「DSH 对照评测」：在 DSH 中运行 `/omk eval <eval.yaml>`，评测使用当前 DSH session 和模型，并将评测产物写入当前项目结果目录。
oh-my-knowledge 的功能「DSH 任务轨迹观测」：`/omk observe` 列出已结束会话，或把指定任务及关联子 agent 的轨迹整理成收件箱报告并提供 Studio 页面链接。
oh-my-knowledge 使用前须知：`/omk observe` 需要 DSH profile 启用 `sessionPersistence`；否则命令提示配置 JSONL 或 SQLite persistence backend。

oh-my-knowledge README · OMK：OMK helps people and agents build, maintain, and reuse valuable knowledge: turn insights, methods, and the reasoning behind decisions from real work and collaboration into readable, traceable knowledge that can be continually revised and used by people and different agents in future tasks.

oh-my-knowledge README · OMK：For agent users and AI application developers, extract candidates from selected work records, review sources and conditions, and keep accumulating and revising knowledge. Select knowledge for a task or generate carriers such as skills and prompts. When you need evidence about a specific change, compare artifact versions under controlled conditions independently. See the guides below for version availability and integration boundaries.

oh-my-knowledge README · Start with local work records：Requires **Node.js ≥22**. The library, artifact authoring, and change review described here require **1.0.0-beta.14 or later**, from the **`@next` channel**; npm `latest` is a separate stable channel. Beta.13 does not include this maintenance UI. Strict extraction, native outcome archives, bounded retries, model-assisted cross-window link review and study review belong to later main development; a Beta.14 version alone does not establish their availability. See the [capability tiers](docs/guides/knowledge/extract-knowledge.md#availability) for release and source boundaries. Read the [migration guide](docs/guides/maintenance/v1-preview-migration.md) before upgrading an older installation.

oh-my-knowledge README · Start with local work records：```bash
npm i -g oh-my-knowledge@next
omk --version
omk studio
```

Open the local URL returned by the command and inspect an existing Codex task and its source records. This step makes no model call; Studio offers source and collection guidance when no conversations exist. Follow the [observation guide](docs/guides/observe/observe-production.md) for other log sources.

oh-my-knowledge README · Start with local work records：Next, choose a conversation and turns under “Knowledge → Candidate review”, inspect the material to send, and extract candidates. **Extraction calls a model**, so prepare an [authenticated runtime](docs/reference/integration/executors.md#prerequisites) first. Link sources in the library, revise outdated content, then explicitly generate and save an artifact. Its detail view lets you review knowledge changes and old and new references. Follow the [knowledge maintenance workflow](docs/guides/knowledge/extract-knowledge.md).

oh-my-knowledge README · When knowledge changes, review its artifacts：In the existing SDK maintenance case, old statements were limited to their historical context, one item was discarded, and another gained a clearer boundary for its static observations. v4 retains three historical references and shows two changes; v5 explicitly selects two currently retained items, while old content and references remain available. [Read the case, sources, and review steps](docs/guides/knowledge/sdk-maintenance-case.md).
section: When knowledge changes, review its artifacts

text: oh-my-knowledge README · When knowledge changes, review its artifacts：This verifies maintenance and reference behavior. It does not verify dynamic SDK effects, time saved, or cross-agent reuse benefits. Retaining knowledge, saving artifacts, using them, and verifying effects are separate records. Complete automatic management and reuse across agents remain in development.

oh-my-knowledge README · Continue with your task：- **Compare two artifacts directly**: preview the plan in the [evaluation quickstart](docs/guides/evaluation/quickstart-skill-eval.md), configure a runtime, then call the model. Fix models and cases, record execution conditions, and inspect decisions, uncertainty, and failed-case evidence.
- **Embed evaluation in a service**: begin with the [offline Node example](docs/guides/integration/eval-runtime.md), complete a traceable comparison, then choose models and configuration as needed.
- **Use OMK inside agents or DSH**: [install the official Skill](docs/guides/evaluation/quickstart-skill-eval.md#use-inside-an-agent), [submit MCP feedback](docs/guides/integration/mcp-integration.md), or use the [DSH host plugin](docs/reference/integration/executors.md#deepseek-harness-prefer-the-host-plugin).
- **Verify an agent’s file changes**: use independent checks in [local task acceptance](docs/guides/evaluation/local-tasks.md), or screen candidate versions with [iterative improvement](docs/guides/evaluation/auto-improve-skills.md).

oh-my-knowledge README · Continue with your task：Starter cases check the workflow; `UNDERPOWERED` is expected. Release decisions need your own domain cases and independent evidence. Observation signals do not establish causality; passing an evaluation does not mean an artifact took effect or a version was published.

oh-my-knowledge README · Look up details and upgrade：Beta APIs and storage contracts may change. Knowledge stays in the explicitly selected workspace; execution evidence and machine preferences have their own storage scopes. Back up before upgrading, then establish new evidence through the migration guide.

oh-my-knowledge README · Security notice：Use a trusted local environment. Tasks, verifiers, and custom assertions execute local code and should be reviewed first; workspace copies are not security sandboxes. Inspect the material before a model call: source records and artifacts may contain sensitive information. The local report server has no authentication and should not be exposed publicly.
